Further, PSI reserves the right to withhold a Promotion reward as well as to limit or refuse your eligibility to participate in any Promotion for any reason in its sole discretion, including, without limitation, based on your wagering patterns or wagering history or if you failed to participate in a Promotion in good faith. Promotion reward recipients will be solely responsible for all federal, state, and local taxes, and for any other fees or costs associated with the Promotion offer received, regardless of whether the Promotion reward, in whole or in part, is used. The Promotion reward value may be reported for tax purposes as required by law. 

  • Players in MA: Promotion rewards valued at $5,000 or more will require a 1099 and will be vetted through the Massachusetts Department of Revenue for any outstanding child-support and state taxes. If the search returns a positive result, then the Promotion reward will be defaulted to the cash value and that outstanding amount will automatically be deducted. Cash reward option will be only available to Massachusetts Department of Revenue intercepted individuals unless otherwise stated in the rules.
  • Players in OH: Promotion rewards valued at $600 or more will require a 1099 and will be vetted through the Ohio Department of Job and Family Services (ODJFS). If the ODJFS search returns a positive result, then the Promotion reward will be defaulted to the cash value and that outstanding amount will be automatically deducted. State and local taxes will be based on the full reward amount and automatically deducted. Cash reward option will be only available to ODJFS intercepted individuals unless otherwise stated in the rules.
